found: Red stretcher bond brick sitting on the recipe's own courses. Each brick is a slightly different red, the mortar is recessed and dark grey, a few bricks carry thin grey soot streaks and there is one pale efflorescence patch near the top left. No lettering, numeral, logo, badge, signature or watermark anywhere in the four crops. Nothing in it reads as a particular building: no window reveal, no pipe, no sign fixing, no shadow of anything outside the tile.
statement: Every texel of every map is inside exactly one of these crops, each written at 1:1 with no resampling, and each was looked at before this set was offered for publication.
